appRoles.description: Allows the app to read user profiles without a signed in user.
Allows the app to read group properties and memberships, and read conversations for all groups, without a signed-in user.

oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Allows users to sign-in to the app, and allows the app to read the profile of signed-in users.
oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDisplayName: Sign in and read user profile
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Allows you to sign in to the app with your organizational account and let the app read your profile.
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDisplayName: Sign you in and read your profile

oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Allows users to sign in to the app with their work or school accounts.
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Allows you to sign in to the app with your work or school account.

oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Allows the app to see your users' basic profile (e.g., name, picture, user name, email address)
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Allows the app to see your basic profile (e.g., name, picture, user name, email address)

oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDescription: Allows the app to see and update the data you gave it access to, even when users are not currently using the app.
oauth2PermissionScopes.adminConsentDisplayName: Maintain access to data you have given it access to
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDescription: Allows the app to see and update the data you gave it access to, even when you are not currently using the app.
oauth2PermissionScopes.userConsentDisplayName: Maintain access to data you have given it access to
